items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Marion Motley and Paul Brown was the coach. That was the first I heard of him. ... [INTERVIEWEE] We also had great baseball, because we had Schoolboy Rowe and Robin, the pitcher?

ctx.x: Yeah, you know, what am I telling you? Well we’re playing Wilkes Barre, Pennsylvania, and this was during a period when we were not allowed to stay in the big hotel, we were relegated to the homes of Miss Brown, Miss Jones, Miss Green and so forth.
Oh, those were the good old days. “Have you had your breakfast?” “No, M’am.”
